privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.disclaimer: This is an informative translation. The Portuguese version is the only legally valid one.

section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.content: CAP Câmbio values the privacy and protection of personal data of its users. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, protect, store, and, when necessary, share your information, in compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD – Law No. 13.709/2018).

section2.title: 2. Information Collected
section2.intro: We collect personal information that you provide directly or that is automatically generated during platform use, including:

section3.title: 3. Purpose of Data Use
section3.item1: Provide and manage access to the exchange rate platform;
section3.item2: Personalize your experience and send price alerts configured by you;
section3.item5: Send important communications about the service (such as updates, maintenance, and changes to terms).

section4.title: 4. Information Sharing
section4.intro: We do not sell or rent your personal data. We only share your information when strictly necessary to:
section4.item1: Comply with legal or regulatory obligations;
section4.item2: Protect the rights, security, and integrity of CAP Câmbio and its users;
section4.item3: Execute essential technical services, such as hosting and infrastructure, always with partners who also respect LGPD.

section5.title: 5. Data Security
section5.content: We adopt appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or improper disclosure. However, no system is completely immune, and we recommend that you also protect your credentials.

section6.title: 6. Data Retention
section6.content: Your data will be stored only for the time necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, except when required by legal or regulatory obligations that require retention for a longer period.

section7.title: 7. Cookies and Similar Technologies
section7.content: This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. The most recent version will always be available on our website.

section8.title: 8. Your Rights as Data Subject
section8.content: To exercise your rights or ask questions, please contact us:

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.disclaimer: This is an informative translation. The Portuguese version is the only legally valid one.

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.content: By accessing and using the CAP Câmbio platform, you declare that you have read, understood, and fully agreed to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any provision, we recommend that you do not use our services.

section2.title: 2. Validity
section2.intro: CAP Câmbio provides two main digital environments with distinct purposes:
section2.item1: Institutional Website: Intended for company presentation, physical store locations (Caxias do Sul, Bento Gonçalves and Passo Fundo), service description (Paper Currency, International Transfers and DHL) and facilitating contact via WhatsApp.
section2.item2: CAP Cotações Platform: Environment restricted to authorized clients, offering real-time currency consultation, customizable alerts, quote history with charts and currency converter based on company prices.
section2.item3: Authorization: Access is granted upon prior registration and discretionary authorization from the CAP team.
section2.item4: Responsibility: The user is solely responsible for safeguarding and maintaining the confidentiality of their access credentials, and sharing with third parties is prohibited.
section2.item5: Features: The platform allows configuration of email and push notifications, as well as partial offline access via PWA technology.

section3.title: 3. Service Description
section3.intro: CAP Câmbio offers an online platform for consulting foreign currency exchange rates and related exchange services. The features include:
section3.item1: Real-time consultation of exchange rates for 16 foreign currencies;
section3.item2: Customizable alert system (rise, fall, and specific value);
section3.item3: Exchange rate history with detailed charts and tables;

section4.title: 4. Proper Use and User Responsibilities
section4.content: All digital content of CAP Câmbio, including brands, logos, texts, images, graphics and source codes, is the exclusive property of the company or its licensors. Reproduction, modification or commercial exploitation of any element is strictly prohibited without prior written authorization.

section5.title: 5. Information and Exchange Rates
section5.intro: By using our services, you agree to:
section5.item2: Not use the system for fraudulent or illegal purposes.
section5.item3: Not interfere with the technical infrastructure or attempt to access restricted areas without authorization.

section6.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
section6.content: CAP Câmbio employs its best efforts to maintain the availability and accuracy of its systems. However, we are not responsible for temporary technical interruptions, connection failures or inaccuracies resulting from delays in market data transmission.

section7.title: 7. Intellectual Property
section7.content: All content, including trademarks, logos, texts, images, and source code, belongs to CAP Câmbio or its licensors. Unauthorized use without prior written authorization is prohibited.

section8.title: 8. Modifications to Terms and Service
section8.content1: We may modify these Terms of Use at any time. Modifications will take effect from publication on this page, with indication of the update date.
section8.content2: If you do not agree with the new terms, you must discontinue use of the platform. Continued use will be interpreted as tacit acceptance of the changes.

section9.title: 9. Applicable Law and Jurisdiction
section9.content: For questions or requests, please contact us via email: capcambio_caxias@hotmail.com.
